summary: Priced concretely: the eleven walls bought 51 commits, 404 agents and 243,999 doc-lines, and 0 lines of game. In this repo's own demonstrated units that is 4-6 SESSION-19-sized sessions (SESSION 19 = 15 commits, 1,886 src+tests insertions, 5 traced garments, gate A5-A MET) or ~5 repeats of commit 741fd31, which promoted 710 nodes to CONTRACT in ONE commit with a 159-line script and a 177-line byte-pin test. The single sharpest number: 404 agents were spent judging 1,824 claims about a 378-line document — 1.07 agents per line of the thing under review — and the lane board those verdicts exist to inform has not changed by one row since 2026-08-13, before a single verdict landed (`git diff 7476add^ HEAD -- docs/GAUNTLET.md | grep -cE '^[-+]\| \*\*L[0-9]'` -> 0). Worse, the blocker that GAUNTLET.md still uses to gate the two cheapest script-lanes died on day two: commit 6ff47f1 (2026-08-14) says "L2 and L3 are UNBLOCKED. L1b is CLOSED BEFORE IT RAN", and `docs/gauntlet/L0/index/resolved_names.json` has existed since 2026-08-14 23:29 — yet `docs/GAUNTLET.md:128,129,144,160` still say L2/L3 need L1b. Every session for ten days has read a doc telling it the cheap chops are blocked. On the analogy: the Axe note's ROI claim is 'meta compounds across every future subject, content is bounded' — and by that exact test 27 days split into 1,533 words of genuinely portable rules living in ~/.claude/ (fail-closed 392, salvage-pattern 679, one-workflow 462) versus 243,999 lines in docs/gauntlet that transfer to zero future subjects and get superseded the moment src/config becomes the source of truth. Roughly 1:1,600. So this was not 100% axe-sharpening as the kickoff assumes — ~99.9% of it was bounded-ROI content work wearing an axe costume, which is the worst quadrant the note never names. RATIO RULING: measured 51:0 (100% axe / 0% chop), outside all three of the note's sanctioned bands (60/40, 30/70, 10/90). Go to 10/90 — the LATE band — because the axe is provably sharp and its learning curve is flat: the last portable rule was written 2026-08-22 while walls #10 (08-23) and #11 (08-24) taught nothing new. Enforced as: of the next 50 commits, at most 5 may touch docs/gauntlet, scripts/gauntlet, GAUNTLET.md, CLAUDE.md or .claude/; at least 45 must touch src/. NEXT CHOP, named: `scripts/skills/transcribeSkills.py` in the exact shape of `scripts/anim/transcribeAnims.py`, emitting `src/config/ogSkills.ts` with 543 measured CONTRACT numbers from `reference/extracted/skilldata.xml`, pinned by a byte-check test in the shape of `tests/a11AnimData.test.ts`.
